worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.summary: Braces itself and drives a rank of heavy metal spikes down a straight line one after another: each pierces the row, deals damage to everyone hit, and shoves them back. The slowest, heaviest and longest-ranged of the family; the lance choice is fewer and harder and can pierce three.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.use.0: A straight volley of heavy spikes at long range
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.use.1: Pierce several enemies lined up in one row
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.use.2: Shove a close target back and reopen the distance
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.descriptio: Each spike deals about %1$s physical damage, and the burst fires %2$s spikes (2-5 natively, set by the user's data).
Spikes fire every %1$s at %2$s blocks/tick, reaching %3$s blocks with up to ±%4$s degrees of spread.

Each spike has a %1$s block hit radius; in flight it passes through up to %2$s more foes (each one it reaches, including the one it finally stops on, takes a hit) and shoves every target %3$s blocks along the line of fire.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.lance.on: Lance: per-spike power x1.3, passes through up to 3 more foes, knockback x1.4 and range x0.95; costs spikes capped at 3, interval +2 ticks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.lance.off: Rapid: up to 5 spikes, a longer range, interval -1 tick and a faster cast; costs per-spike power x0.9, passing through only 1-2 more foes and a smaller knockback.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.growth.0: From level %1$s the per-spike power rises to %2$s and the burst grows to %3$s spikes.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.growth.1: From level %1$s the per-spike power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.spikecannon.preference: On: per-spike power x1.3, passes through up to 3 more foes and knockback x1.4, good against a lined-up row; costs spikes capped at 3, range x0.95, interval +2 ticks, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +5 ticks. Off (rapid): up to 5 spikes, a longer range, a tighter interval and a faster cast, at the cost of per-spike power x0.9, passing through only 1-2 more foes and a smaller knockback.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: targets within 4 blocks rank higher so the pierce shoves them away; off: all targets score the same.
